title: IT-Säkerhetsarkitekt
description:
Att bygga en säker digital framtid handlar om mer än teknik. Det handlar om att hitta rätt balans mellan innovation, risk och affärsvärde. På SBAB står vi mitt i en spännande utveckling där AI, molnteknik och modern produktutveckling skapar nya möjligheter. Nu söker vi en **IT-**säkerhetsarkitekt som vill vara med och forma vägen framåt.

**Att jobba på SBAB**


Hos oss blir du en del av ett lag av bjussiga proffs som hjälper varandra att lyckas. Vi är tillräckligt små för att du ska kunna påverka på riktigt och tillräckligt stora för att göra skillnad i en hel bransch. Vi kombinerar omtanke med genomförandekraft och tror på att de bästa lösningarna skapas tillsammans.

**Vardagen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt**


Du tillhör området Tech Security, som ansvarar för IT-säkerhetsövervakning, incidenthantering, hot- och omvärldsbevakning samt de tekniska verktyg och plattformar som skyddar SBAB. I rollen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt samarbetar du nära andra arkitekter, utvecklings- och driftteam och arbetar tätt ihop med IT-säkerhetschefen.

**Utveckla SBAB:s säkerhetsförmåga**: Du ansvarar för att vidareutveckla och förvalta SBAB:s tekniska säkerhetsstyrning samt säkerhetsarkitektur. I en miljö präglad av molntjänster, AI och automation säkerställer du att säkerhet integreras tidigt i utvecklings- och förändringsinitiativ och att säkerhetskrav omsätts till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken. Rollen innebär ett stort mandat att påverka hur säkerhet byggs in i framtida lösningar och arbetssätt.

**Omsätta säkerhetskrav i praktiken**: Du kravställer mot övriga IT-verksamheten inom IT-säkerhet. Du kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med ett operativt arbetssätt. Genom att definiera riktlinjer, delta i projekt, genomföra riskanalyser kopplade till tekniska initiativ samt föreslå och driva igenom säkra lösningar säkerställer du att säkerhetskrav integreras i arkitektur, plattformar och tekniska initiativ på ett sätt som skapar affärsvärde.

**Vara ett rådgivande stöd**: Du fungerar som ett viktigt stöd till våra utvecklingsteam, arkitekter och andra intressenter internt. Genom att förankra och förklara säkerhetsrisker och säkerhetskrav på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt bidrar du till välgrundade beslut och hållbara lösningar.

**Utveckla och stärka bankens leverantörsuppföljning:** Ur ett IT-säkerhetsperspektiv arbetar du i ett nära samarbete med exempelvis inköp och juridik för att vidareutveckla vår leverantörsuppföljning. Rollen säkerställer att säkerhetskrav efterlevs i både interna och outsourcade lösningar.


Rollen kombinerar strategiskt arbete med praktiskt deltagande i lösningar. Du kommer inte bara att definiera krav och riktlinjer, utan också vara en aktiv part i projekt, riskanalyser och tekniska initiativ.

**Kollegan vi söker**


Vi söker dig som har en teknisk förståelse och trivs i en roll som länk mellan säkerhet, arkitektur och verksamhetsstyrning.


För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:

* Har erfarenhet av teknisk IT-arkitektur och molnarkitektur, gärna AWS.
* Förstår moderna plattformar, integrationer, IAM, Zero Trust och CI/CD.
* Har erfarenhet av att ta fram styrning, arkitekturprinciper och tekniska krav.
* Har kunskap inom säker användning av AI, agentisk AI och ny teknik.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från bank-, finans- eller försäkringssektorn, eller om du tidigare varit med och byggt säkerhets- eller AI-plattformar.


För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du har ett gott omdöme och förmåga att fatta välgrundade beslut även i komplexa situationer där olika perspektiv, risker och behov behöver vägas mot varandra. Du har ett helhetsperspektiv och kan se hur tekniska vägval påverkar såväl arkitekturen som verksamheten i stort. Samtidigt är du pragmatisk och lösningsorienterad, med fokus på att hitta vägar framåt som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du är även skicklig på att kommunicera och förankra dina budskap hos olika intressenter samt kan på ett pedagogiskt och övertygande sätt presentera risker, rekommendationer och beslut.

title: Team Manager – Data Intelligence
description:
* Urval sker löpande
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Som Team Manager för Data Intelligence leder och har du yttersta personalansvaret för ett engagerat team med ansvar för utveckling, drift och vidareutveckling av Tres nordiska data- och analysplattformar. Du kliver in i en nyckelroll där du får möjlighet att forma hur data används som strategisk tillgång i organisationen och bidra till att göra Tre ännu mer datadrivet.


Tillsammans med ditt team skapar du förutsättningar för bättre beslut, effektivare processer och ökad affärsnytta genom tillförlitlig, tillgänglig, AI-redo och värdeskapande data.


**Om rollen**

I rollen som Team Manager inom Enterprise Solutions får du ett brett ansvar där teknik, affärsnytta och ledarskap möts. Du leder ett team om 10 personer med BI-kompetens inom utveckling och drift. Teamet ansvarar för hela kedjan från kravanalys till produktion, att bygga, integrera och automatisera dataflöden samt säkerställa hög datakvalitet, prestanda och tillgänglighet för att leverera rätt data till verksamhetens rapportering- och analysbehov. Du har ett helhetsansvar för leverans, prioritering och operativ stabilitet samtidigt som du driver utvecklingen av arbetssätt, verktyg och processer framåt.


Du arbetar nära Product Owners, arkitekter, Data Strategy och verksamheten för att säkerställa att data tillgängliggörs på ett säkert, skalbart och affärsnära sätt. En viktig del av rollen är att bidra till nordisk harmonisering av datalandskap, informationsstrukturer och processer där verksamheter i både Sverige och Danmark ska kunna arbeta utifrån gemensamma definitioner och datagrunder.


Rollen innebär även ett nära samarbete med ansvariga för Data Governance och informationsarkitektur för att stärka arbetet kring datakvalitet, metadata, masterdata och styrning. Du bidrar till att etablera strukturer som gör data mer tillförlitlig, tillgänglig och användbar över hela organisationen. Samtidigt befinner vi oss i en spännande transformationsresa där våra dataflöden moderniseras och där pågående förändringsinitiativ ställer höga krav på robusta datapipelines, hållbar datamodellering och en långsiktigt skalbar plattform. Här får du en central roll i att driva den utvecklingen framåt.  

  



**I din roll som ledare**

Som ledare på Tre är du tydlig och framåtriktad samtidigt som du är närvarande och coachande i vardagen. Du skapar förutsättningar för teamet att ta ett gemensamt ansvar för hela leveransen, från datakälla till insikt.


Du driver aktivt en kultur präglad av samarbete, ansvarstagande och kontinuerligt lärande. Samtidigt skapar du tydlighet och riktning i en miljö där förändring, innovation och utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen. Rollen handlar lika mycket om människor som teknik. Du leder ett team med hög kompetens, skapar rätt förutsättningar för utveckling och hjälper organisationen att omsätta datastrategi till konkreta resultat.


Som Team Manager verkar du i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär, där du säkerställer att initiativ inom data och analys bidrar till affärsnytta, bättre beslutsfattande och långsiktig verksamhetsutveckling.


**Du kan se fram emot att**

* vara med och stärka Tres förmåga inom Business Intelligence, Data Governance och datadrivet beslutsfattande
* vara en del av att leverera kritisk infrastruktur och bidra direkt till samhällsnyttan
* kombinera strategisk höjd med operativt ledarskap i en roll som både utvecklar och utmanar dig
* vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work, samt arbeta i en organisation som är stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar
**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Lite mer om dig**

Du är en trygg och coachande ledare som trivs med att utveckla både människor och verksamhet. Du har tidigare haft formellt personalansvar med direktrapporterande medarbetare, där du haft det övergripande ansvaret för teamet, inklusive lönesättning, medarbetarutveckling och målarbete. Genom tydlighet, engagemang och tillit skapar du förutsättningar för högpresterande team att lyckas tillsammans.



Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av att leda arbete inom Business Intelligence, Data Engineering eller Data Warehouse och att du är van att driva teknisk leverans i komplexa miljöer där många system, intressenter och prioriteringar behöver samverka.


Du har en god förståelse för hela dataflödet – från datakällor, integrationer och datapipelines till datamodellering, visualisering och konsumtion. Du har också erfarenhet av att arbeta med områden som datakvalitet, metadata, spårbarhet, governance och masterdata. Vidare är du van att arbeta med DevOps-principer, agila arbetssätt och kontinuerlig förbättring. Du har förmågan att omsätta strategi till konkreta planer, skapa framdrift i komplexa initiativ och få människor med dig längs vägen.


För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara en skicklig relationsbyggare som kan skapa samsyn mellan teknik, affär och organisation. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska och är duktig på att göra komplexa frågor begripliga och relevanta för olika målgrupper.


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**



Vi tar emot ansökningar via den här annonsen och går igenom dem löpande. Du behöver inte skicka med ett personligt brev, bifoga ditt CV och besvara frågorna i samband med din ansökan.


**Så här ser vägen till Tre ut:** Vi börjar med ett urval, följt av tester och en kortare telefonintervju. Därefter får du träffa den rekryterande chefen i en första intervju, följt av en kompetensbaserad intervju med vår Talent Acquisition Partner. För slutkandidaten ingår även referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll.



Vi använder tester som en del av urvalet för att skapa en så objektiv och rättvis bedömning som möjligt. Vi intervjuar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan, tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
* Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
* Hundzon & gym i 3huset
* Subventionerad lunch
* Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar
* Generösa bonusmodeller eller provisioner
**Om företaget**
----------------

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.



Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.



När du startar din resa på Tre finns det oändliga möjligheter att växa och utvecklas med oss.



**WE THINK LIKE CHALLENGERS** - I en föränderlig värld, är vi på Tre nyfikna och ständigt öppna för nya lösningar. På Tre anpassar vi vägen framåt allt eftersom vi provar och lär oss vad som funkar bäst.



**WE WORK LIKE CHAMPIONS** - På Tre gör vi alltid vårt bästa. Vi känner ägandeskap för vår uppgift, sätter tydliga mål och håller fokus på det som gör mest nytta för affären.  




**WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES** - På Tre är vi schyssta kollegor. Vi samarbetar med varandra över team och funktioner, vi bollar idéer, ger och tar emot feedback.

title: AI Platform Engineer till GS1 Sweden
description:

Nu söker GS1 Sweden en AI Platform Engineer. I den här rollen bygger och förvaltar du vår plattform för utveckling, driftsättning och drift av våra AI- och maskininlärningsprodukter. Du har ett tydligt fokus på plattform, molninfrastruktur och drift (inklusive Kubernetes, containrar och IaC) och arbetar med hela livscykeln – från kravinsamling och teknisk design till säker driftsättning, övervakning, kostnadsstyrning och skalning i produktion enligt moderna DevOps-, MLOps- och LLMOps-principer. GS1 arbetar i Azure, men du kan också ha med dig relevant erfarenhet från andra molnplattformar, exempelvis AWS eller GCP. Det viktigaste är att du har en god teknisk grund och viljan att lära dig deras miljö.

### **Vad GS1 erbjuder**

* En varm och professionell kultur: En organisation som värnar samarbete, lärande och ett hållbart arbetsliv, med attraktiva villkor och förmåner.
* Påverkan på global nivå: Möjlighet att arbeta med affärskritiska lösningar och dataflöden som driver standardisering och digitalisering för tusentals företag i Sverige och internationellt.
* Modern teknik i framkant: En central roll i att etablera och forma arbetssätt kring MLOps, LLMOps och molnbaserad plattformsinfrastruktur.
* Tvärfunktionellt samarbete: Ett nära samarbete med Data Scientists, AI Solutions Architects, utvecklare, produktägare och verksamhet i en öppen och prestigelös miljö.
* Trivsel och gemenskap: Ett modernt kontor mitt i centrala Stockholm och studio i Hammarby Sjöstad.

### **Arbetsuppgifter**


I rollen ansvarar du för att möjliggöra driftsättning och stabil drift av AI-lösningar i produktion, och fungera som det tekniska navet mellan AI-utveckling och IT/drift.

**Ditt uppdrag innebär bland annat att:**

* Bygga och förvalta plattform, molninfrastruktur och utvecklingsmiljöer för AI-lösningar, inklusive containrar, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD-flöden.
* Ansvara för CI/CD, testautomatisering och övervakning för att säkerställa kvalitet och snabb leverans av ML-lösningar.
* Utveckla, designa och underhålla robusta pipelines för AI-drivna tjänster och funktioner.
* Ansvara för stabil drift av AI-tjänster och plattformskomponenter i produktion, inklusive larmhantering, incidenthantering, prestandaoptimering och kostnadsstyrning (FinOps/modellkostnader).
* Samarbeta nära med Data Scientists, AI Solutions Architect, Full Stack Developer och IT kring driftbarhet, kodgranskning, arkitektur och best practices.Delta i teknisk design och kodgranskning med fokus på infrastruktur, pipelines och driftbarhet
* Proaktivt hålla dig uppdaterad om nya tekniker, ramverk och designmönster inom AI/ML samt bidra till kontinuerlig innovation och kunskapsspridning inom organisationen.

### **Vem är du?**


Vi söker dig som trivs i skärningspunkten mellan modern mjukvaruutveckling, plattformsarkitektur och drift. Du är pragmatisk och trivs med att ta tekniskt ägarskap från idé till stabil drift. Eftersom rollen fungerar som en bro mellan AI-teamet, Services och den centrala IT-organisationen har du lätt för att samarbeta med olika kompetenser och trivs med att arbeta innovativt och framåtlutat.  

  



Du behöver inte vara expert på alla tekniker som nämns eller ha arbetat i exakt samma miljö tidigare. Vi tror att du har en stabil teknisk grund inom exempelvis DevOps, plattform eller molninfrastruktur och praktisk erfarenhet av att bidra till driftsättning eller drift av tjänster. Kanske har du arbetat med en annan molnplattform, andra verktyg eller några – men inte alla – delar av tekniken vi använder. Det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på AI och vill utvecklas vidare inom plattformar för AI- och ML-lösningar.

  

Vi uppskattar dig som är nyfiken och prestigelös: du tar ansvar för ditt lärande, söker kunskap och ber om hjälp när det behövs. Du tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar, lösa problem metodiskt och dela med dig av det du lär dig. Med stöd från erfarna kollegor får du möjlighet att utvecklas och successivt växa in i rollen.

 **Vi letar efter dig som har:**

* Praktisk erfarenhet från en roll inom DevOps, plattform, molninfrastruktur eller liknande, där du har arbetat med driftsättning och drift av tjänster i molnmiljö.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av containrar och Kubernetes, med fokus på att driftsätta och förvalta applikationer i befintliga kluster, samt erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, gärna Terraform.
* Erfarenhet av att bygga och underhålla automatiserade CI/CD-pipelines och testmiljöer.
* Intresse för AI och maskininlärning och för hur prototyper utvecklas till stabila, säkra och kostnadseffektiva tjänster i produktion.
* Erfarenhet av övervakning, loggning och larmhantering i produktionsmiljöer (t.ex. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog eller molnleverantörers inbyggda verktyg).
* Förståelse för molnsäkerhet, nätverk och kostnadsoptimering i molnmiljöer (t.ex. Azure, AWS eller GCP).
* Praktisk erfarenhet av Python och förmåga att läsa, bearbeta och produktionsanpassa kod, exempelvis genom att paketera prototyper till fungerande tjänster.
* God kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift, på såväl svenska som engelska.

 **Meriterande:**

* Erfarenhet av att sätta upp pipelines för storskaliga språkmodeller (LLM:er), vektordatabaser eller RAG-arkitekturer.
* Bakgrund inom arbete med regulatoriska krav, datakvalitet och compliance i molnmiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av MLOps eller LLMOps, exempelvis driftsättning av modeller och automatiserade pipelines för AI-/ML-tjänster.

### **Om GS1 Sweden**


Idag använder mer än två miljoner företag globalt GS1s standarder. Vissa branscher använder flera av våra standarder och tjänster och har kommit längre på sin resa att utveckla ett digitalt affärsspråk. I Sverige har dagligvarubranschen kommit långt men vi jobbar även aktivt med foodservice, bygg, detaljhandeln, apotek, sjukvård, transport- och logistik. Idag har vi fler än 15 000 kunder.


GS1 Sweden är not-for-profit och för att leverera kundnytta arbetar vi tillsammans med våra användare. Det vi gör, gör vi utifrån våra kunders behov och efterfrågan. All utveckling och underhåll av GS1:s standarder och tjänster sker tillsammans med våra användare. Våra användargrupper är öppna för alla kunder och alla våra standarder är branschneutrala.


Vi är cirka 90 anställda, alla med olika kompetens och bakgrund. Vi håller till på vårt moderna kontor mitt i centrala Stockholm och i vår studio i Hammarby Sjöstad. Våra medarbetare tar ofta initiativ till roliga aktiviteter på, och efter jobbet. Vad sägs om lunchlöpning, hälsosatsningar, AW:s eller varför inte ta en kort paus i vår återhämtningsfåtölj? Mer information finns på jobb.gs1.se eller LinkedIn.

* **Placering:** Kontor i centrala Stockholm.
* **Rapportering:** Du rapporterar till Head of AI.

### **Vill du veta mer?**


I denna rekrytering samarbetar GS1 med Winona. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Charlotte Runsbech på charlotte.runsbech@winonagroup.com eller ansvarig researcher Liisa Unenge på liisa.unenge@winonagroup.com hos Winona.

title: Analytics/ML Engineer - Data Team
description:
10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that. With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.
  
  

Founded in 2022, and with 800+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034. About the role: You'll join Aira's central data team, working across the entire customer journey, from acquisition and sales to technical design, installation and live heat pump data. Our work has a direct impact on the tools and processes used across Aira.
  
  

We're moving from traditional BI towards self-service analytics, where teams can explore data and answer questions themselves. This will allow us to spend less time on ad hoc reporting and more time solving complex problems using statistics, optimisation and machine learning. The work is varied. One day you might build data models and metrics for self-service analytics, the next you might use machine learning, statistical modelling or thermodynamics to improve how we design and sell our products.
  
  

We’re looking for someone who enjoys both sides of that spectrum: strong analytics engineering and quantitative problem solving, combined with a keen business mindset. What you’ll be doing: Build and maintain data models and metrics using SQL and dbt. Work with Product teams to define KPIs, track performance and identify areas for improvement. Develop the semantic layer that powers self-service analytics across Aira.
  
  

Use statistics, experimentation, optimisation and machine learning to improve our products and processes. Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude in your day-to-day work. What you’ll bring to the role: 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data science, machine learning or a similar quantitative role. Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
  
  

Experience with data transformation and dimensional data modelling. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle problems that don't have an obvious solution. An interest in understanding the business and working closely with Product teams to improve how things work. Bonus: A strong quantitative background in mathematics, physics, engineering, statistics or a related field.
  
  

Experience developing or deploying machine learning models. Experience with statistical modelling, experimentation or causal analysis. Experience working with optimisation problems, physical models or time-series/telemetry data. Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure.
  
  

**What you can expect:** Work close to the decisions that shape Aira's customer journey, where your insights can translate directly into changes to our products and processes. Help move Aira from traditional BI towards self-service analytics, creating more room for advanced modelling and ML. Work on a broad range of problems spanning analytics engineering, statistics, data science, machine learning and real-world physical systems. Collaborate closely with Product teams and diverse teams across our international markets.
  
  

Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities. Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment. Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world. What is in it for you?
  
  

Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities. Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally. Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment. Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
  
  

Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth. Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away. At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion.
  
  

We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: HR Business Partner - Tieto Banktech (m/f/d)
description:

Job Description  

  

We are looking for a **HR Business Partner** who wants to make a meaningful impact on business performance, leadership, and organizational development at Tieto Banktech!


Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics’ most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience.


Tech Operations is Banktech’s common delivery center responsible for running and assuring stable, secure and resilient 24/7 operations across applications, platforms and infrastructure. *The unit will be established on 1 January 2027.* Tech Operation, will represents a new merged delivery center across Banktech, bringing together approximately 300 employees.


As a HR Business Partner, you will have the opportunity to shape how our business grows, transforms, and develops its capabilities. You will work closely with leaders across an international organization of approximately 280 professionals, influencing decisions that connect business strategy, people, and technology.


**This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional HR Business partnering and take an active role in building an organization equipped for the future** — in a business where technological development, continuous improvement, and the ability to adapt are essential to success.

  

**When joining Tieto Banktech as a HR Business Partner**


You will join a skilled team of HR Business Partners, People & Culture professionals, HR Operations specialists, and business leaders. We work collaboratively, share knowledge, and continuously develop our approach to supporting the business.


In this role, you will be a trusted advisor to leaders and an active contributor to business development. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic priorities, challenge existing practices, and turn organizational needs into concrete actions.

  

**Your key responsibilities will include:**


* **Influencing business decisions:** Partner with senior leaders to translate business strategy into people priorities, challenge assumptions, and support decisions that strengthen business performance.
* **Driving organizational transformation:** Play an active role in organizational change, business transformation, and growth initiatives, helping leaders navigate complexity and build readiness for the future.
* **Developing leadership and talent:** Strengthen leadership capabilities, talent development, performance management, succession planning, and workforce planning to ensure the organization has the right skills and capabilities.
* **Building an effective organization:** Support organizational design and development, helping teams operate effectively and adapt to changing business needs.
* **Strengthening employee relations:** Work closely with employee representatives and unions to maintain constructive dialogue and support sustainable people practices in line with Norwegian labour law.
* **Turning people data into business insights:** Use People Analytics and workforce insights to identify opportunities, inform decisions, and improve organizational effectiveness.
* **Transforming the way HR works:** Collaborate with local and global colleagues to improve People & Culture processes, tools, and ways of working.
* **Exploring new technology and innovation:** Contribute to the adoption of digital HR solutions, automation, and AI-enabled tools that create new opportunities for HR and the wider business.

Your impact will extend beyond individual HR processes. You will help leaders build stronger teams, make better decisions, and develop the organizational capabilities needed to support continued business growth.

  

**Who we are looking for**


* We are looking for an experienced HR professional who combines strong HR expertise with business acumen, strategic thinking, and the confidence to influence decisions at senior levels.
* You understand that effective HR partnering is about more than providing advice — it is about understanding what drives the business, anticipating future needs, and helping leaders translate strategy into results.
* You are comfortable working in a changing and complex environment, navigating ambiguity and balancing business needs, people considerations, and organizational priorities.

**We believe you have:**


* 8+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Partner, or in a comparable HR role.
* Solid knowledge of Norwegian labour law and experience working with unions and employee representatives.
* Proven experience advising senior leaders and supporting organizational change in complex environments, combined with strong stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to connect business objectives with effective people strategies.
* Experience working in international and matrixed organizations.
* Fluency in Norwegian and English, both verbally and in writing.
  

**We also believe you have**


* An interest in People Analytics, digital HR, AI, and modern employee experience solutions.
* Experience in banking, financial services, fintech, technology, or another knowledge-intensive industry.
  

**We offer a role with business impact. An environment driven by technology. Room to grow.**


As a HR Business Partner, you will work at the intersection of business, people, and technology, with direct access to senior leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions that shape the organization. Your work will contribute to business performance, leadership effectiveness, and the development of capabilities that support our long-term ambitions.


We believe growth comes from taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines, and continuously developing new capabilities. Here, you will have the opportunity to broaden your perspective, strengthen your strategic HR expertise, and contribute to meaningful organizational change.

We look forward to your application!

Hope to hear from you soon!

title: Senior Cyber Security Architect / Cloud Security Architect
description:
**About Us**



Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by eight Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Cape Town, Johannesburg and Paris.

  

With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, **Integrity360** delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.

  

At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you

 **The Role**



We are looking for an experienced **Security Architect / Cloud Security Architect** who combines strong architectural thinking with hands-on technical security experience.

  

For us, that combination matters.



We are not looking for someone who has worked only with governance, frameworks and documentation. We are looking for someone who understands the technology behind the architecture and is comfortable working with engineers, security teams and customers to turn security requirements into practical solutions.



You will help customers design, secure and improve cloud and hybrid environments, make critical technical security decisions, and support security transformation initiatives from architecture and assessment through implementation.

 **What you'll be doing**



Depending on the customer and assignment, you may:


* Design security architectures for cloud and hybrid environments
* Design and improve **Zero Trust** architectures
* Work with cloud security platforms and technologies across Microsoft Azure and/or AWS
* Work with technologies such as Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, CrowdStrike, Wiz and other CNAPP/EDR/XDR platforms
* Design and improve SIEM, security monitoring and detection capabilities
* Perform technical security, cloud and risk assessments
* Design cloud security controls, hardening strategies and security guardrails
* Work with **CNAPP, CSPM and CWPP** capabilities
* Support vulnerability and exposure management initiatives
* Design security around networks, infrastructure, identities and cloud workloads
* Support incident response and security operations from an architectural perspective
* Work with DevSecOps teams on security automation, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD security
* Translate business and security requirements into practical technical solutions
* Act as a senior technical advisor in customer engagements

  


**What we're looking for**



You probably have around 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with a background combining technical security and architecture.

  

Your career may have developed through roles such as:



Security Engineer Cloud Security Engineer Lead Security Engineer Security Architect



What matters most to us is not the exact job titles you have held, but that your architectural capability is built on a strong technical foundation.

 **We are particularly interested in experience across several of the following areas:**


* Security architecture and technical security design
* Cloud security architecture
* Microsoft Azure and/or AWS security
* Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, CrowdStrike, Wiz or similar security platforms
* Zero Trust
* CNAPP / CSPM / CWPP
* Cloud security controls and hardening
* Vulnerability and exposure management
* SIEM / EDR / XDR
* Incident response and security operations
* DevSecOps and security automation
* Infrastructure as Code, for example Terraform
* Network and infrastructure security
* Hybrid cloud security

  


**Nice to have**



Experience in some of the following would be a plus:


* Microsoft Defender for Cloud / Defender XDR
* Microsoft Sentinel
* AWS Security Services
* Palo Alto Prisma Cloud
* CrowdStrike
* Wiz
* Kubernetes and container security
* Threat modelling
* Security architecture frameworks
* ISO 27001
* NIS2
* PCI DSS
* Designing or transforming SOC, SIEM or XDR solutions
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AZ-500 or equivalent
* Swedish Language Skills

  


**The kind of person we think will thrive**



You are comfortable discussing security strategy and architecture with senior stakeholders, and equally comfortable sitting down with engineers to work through how the solution should actually be implemented.



You understand governance, risk and security frameworks, but **technology is where you built your foundation**.



You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership of complex security challenges where there is not always an obvious answer.

  

You don't need to know every technology on our list. What matters is that you have **strong security fundamentals, deep experience in some areas and the ability to quickly understand new technologies and environments**.



If you want to combine **architecture, engineering and customer advisory work** in the same role, we'd like to hear from you.

  



 #LI-PM2

title: Full Stack Product Engineer
company: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
description:
Merch that moves business needs a platform that moves just as fast. From scattered purchases without brand control, to the magic that happens when it all clicks: merch that makes a real impact, on one global platform customized for each client, as if they built it themselves. That’s what we’re building at Exakt. The platform is up and running, but this is only the beginning.
  
  

Now comes the most advanced part, and we’re looking for an engineer with the drive and the skills to build it on a global scale. What you’ll do You’ll build and own our merch platform, full stack: TypeScript and React on the frontend, Node APIs in the middle and a MedusaJS headless commerce backend, all running on GCP. It’s live with our first clients, and the codebase is still young enough that your decisions will stick. From here, you’ll: Own the platform end to end, from architecture to checkout Refine and develop the product logic.
  
  

One t-shirt can come in 62 colors and seven sizes, from several suppliers, production partners and locations. Find new ways to make it all run even more smoothly Take our client dashboard further, with the advanced features our clients didn’t know they needed, and even more transparency around orders, statistics and the environmental impact of what they buy Automate the manual work, on the platform and behind the scenes, so the team can spend more time on the creative work Set the technical direction with our founder, and help shape the team as we grow Who you are You enjoy figuring out what’s needed and making it happen without waiting to be asked. And you’re curious about the business behind the code, whether you’re shaping a feature or talking ideas through with a client, in English. You’re resourceful, and happy to use a smart existing solution instead of reinventing it You bring experience and an open mind.
  
  

You know how to move fast, and you’re always curious about new ways of working You know when speed matters more than perfection, and you make sure the quick fix doesn’t become permanent You work AI-first, and take security and client data just as seriously You like people, and you’d rather be at the office with the team than on mute You’re comfortable across backend and frontend, and our designers take care of the design. Experience with e-commerce, Medusa or multi-tenant platforms is a plus, but not a must. Tech you’ll work with We’re guessing you already have the essentials. The limited editions are a bonus, and the rest you’ll pick up along the way.
  
  

**The essentials:** TypeScript, React, Node, PostgreSQL, Git, and GCP or a similar cloud platform The limited editions: MedusaJS, Next.js, Redis, Prisma, Terraform, Clerk, Stripe About Exakt Exakt, the world’s boldest merch agency since 2004. Bold, but true. We start with who a brand wants to reach and what it wants to say, and help turn that into products people keep, use and remember. Our clients feel safe with us.
  
  

They know they’ll get the right thing, on time and delivered to the right place. We’ve run webshops for our clients for more than 10 years. Now we’re scaling up our platform, continuously building new processes around our clients’ needs and our own workflow efficiency, and automating more and more of what has been done by hand. The whole process, and the service and ownership we’re known for, become transparent and easy to follow.
  
  

With new print techniques, new ways of working with our print partners and years of industry know-how, we have turned our knowledge into a platform that’s unique in our industry. Picture a company where everyone, from sales and marketing to HR and finance, gets the merch they need from one place. Always on brand and always the strongest choice for the target group, whether it’s printed on demand, custom-made or shipped from stock, with full control over costs and climate impact. Behind it sits a multi-tenant platform built around each client.
  
  

There’s no off-the-shelf solution for this, so we’re building our own. We work with brands like Samsung, Electrolux and KRY, and things are going well: we’re profitable, growing fast and have never needed venture capital. Put our merch expertise together with a platform that handles every part of it, and you get something no one else offers. Why Exakt You’ll have real ownership of the tech from day one, with the influence of a startup in a company that’s already on solid ground.
  
  

Exakt is known in our industry for always being a step ahead, in how we work with ideas, proposals, solutions and suppliers, so you really get the best of both worlds. We’re a team of eight with zero prestige, and we’re growing, looking for the right expertise to expand our team in every area. We support each other through whatever comes our way, celebrate together, eat lunch together and take our merch-cap throwing competitions a little too seriously. You’ll find us at our office on Lidingö, where client work happens in English and office chat in Swedish, so you’ll need to understand it.
  
  

Apply Sound like you? We’d love to hear from you. We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no need to wait. Curious about something first?
  
  

Emelie is helping us find the right person and is happy to answer anything about the role: emelie.stjarnas@ants.se

title: HR Business Partner - Tieto Banktech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**  

We are looking for a **HR Business Partner** who wants to make a meaningful impact on business performance, leadership, and organizational development at Tieto Banktech!


Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics’ most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience.


Tech Operations is Banktech’s common delivery center responsible for running and assuring stable, secure and resilient 24/7 operations across applications, platforms and infrastructure. *The unit will be established on 1 January 2027.* Tech Operation, will represents a new merged delivery center across Banktech, bringing together approximately 300 employees.


As a HR Business Partner, you will have the opportunity to shape how our business grows, transforms, and develops its capabilities. You will work closely with leaders across an international organization of approximately 280 professionals, influencing decisions that connect business strategy, people, and technology.

**This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional HR Business partnering and take an active role in building an organization equipped for the future** — in a business where technological development, continuous improvement, and the ability to adapt are essential to success.

 **When joining Tieto Banktech as a HR Business Partner**


You will join a skilled team of HR Business Partners, People & Culture professionals, HR Operations specialists, and business leaders. We work collaboratively, share knowledge, and continuously develop our approach to supporting the business.


In this role, you will be a trusted advisor to leaders and an active contributor to business development. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic priorities, challenge existing practices, and turn organizational needs into concrete actions.

 **Your key responsibilities will include:**

* **Influencing business decisions:** Partner with senior leaders to translate business strategy into people priorities, challenge assumptions, and support decisions that strengthen business performance.
* **Driving organizational transformation:** Play an active role in organizational change, business transformation, and growth initiatives, helping leaders navigate complexity and build readiness for the future.
* **Developing leadership and talent:** Strengthen leadership capabilities, talent development, performance management, succession planning, and workforce planning to ensure the organization has the right skills and capabilities.
* **Building an effective organization:** Support organizational design and development, helping teams operate effectively and adapt to changing business needs.
* **Strengthening employee relations:** Work closely with employee representatives and unions to maintain constructive dialogue and support sustainable people practices in line with Norwegian labour law.
* **Turning people data into business insights:** Use People Analytics and workforce insights to identify opportunities, inform decisions, and improve organizational effectiveness.
* **Transforming the way HR works:** Collaborate with local and global colleagues to improve People & Culture processes, tools, and ways of working.
* **Exploring new technology and innovation:** Contribute to the adoption of digital HR solutions, automation, and AI-enabled tools that create new opportunities for HR and the wider business.


Your impact will extend beyond individual HR processes. You will help leaders build stronger teams, make better decisions, and develop the organizational capabilities needed to support continued business growth.

 **Who we are looking for**

* We are looking for an experienced HR professional who combines strong HR expertise with business acumen, strategic thinking, and the confidence to influence decisions at senior levels.
* You understand that effective HR partnering is about more than providing advice — it is about understanding what drives the business, anticipating future needs, and helping leaders translate strategy into results.
* You are comfortable working in a changing and complex environment, navigating ambiguity and balancing business needs, people considerations, and organizational priorities.

**We believe you have:**

* 8+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Partner, or in a comparable HR role.
* Solid knowledge of Norwegian labour law and experience working with unions and employee representatives.
* Proven experience advising senior leaders and supporting organizational change in complex environments, combined with strong stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to connect business objectives with effective people strategies.
* Experience working in international and matrixed organizations.
* Fluency in Norwegian and English, both verbally and in writing.

 **We also believe you have**

* An interest in People Analytics, digital HR, AI, and modern employee experience solutions.
* Experience in banking, financial services, fintech, technology, or another knowledge-intensive industry.

 **We offer a role with business impact. An environment driven by technology. Room to grow.**


As a HR Business Partner, you will work at the intersection of business, people, and technology, with direct access to senior leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions that shape the organization. Your work will contribute to business performance, leadership effectiveness, and the development of capabilities that support our long-term ambitions.


We believe growth comes from taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines, and continuously developing new capabilities. Here, you will have the opportunity to broaden your perspective, strengthen your strategic HR expertise, and contribute to meaningful organizational change.

 **Did we get you inspired?**


We look forward to your application!


Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today! For more information or questions, please contact Talent Acquisition team recruitmentinbanking@tieto.com


Hope to hear from you soon!

 **Location:** Solna, Sweden

  

*We perform background checks on all final candidates.*

 *Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*

 **Additional Information**  

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.  

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**  

* Tieto only communicates via **@tieto.com** email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

title: Product Owner
description:
* Ansök senast: 22 november 2026
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

**Vi söker en Product Owner som vill vara med och forma framtidens digitala kundupplevelser**

På Tre befinner vi oss mitt i en spännande förändringsresa där vi utvecklar våra digitala kanaler, arbetssätt och kundupplevelser för framtiden. Nu söker vi en **Product Owner** som vill vara med och driva den utvecklingen framåt.


Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan affär, teknik, data och kundupplevelse. Du kommer in i ett läge där mycket händer samtidigt och där du får vara med och påverka både riktning, prioriteringar och framtida lösningar.


**Om rollen**  

Som Product Owner ansvarar du för att omsätta affärsstrategi, kundbehov och insikter till konkreta prioriteringar och leveranser. Du äger roadmap och backlog för ditt område och säkerställer att teamet fokuserar på det som skapar störst värde för både kunder och affären.


Du blir en del av vårt Online Consumer Market-team och kliver in i en spännande förändringsresa där affär, teknik och kundupplevelse utvecklas parallellt. Tillsammans med utvecklare, designers, analytiker och andra specialistroller driver du arbetet framåt och skapar samsyn kring prioriteringar och mål.


Produktområdet är idag kopplat till våra digitala kund- och självserviceupplevelser, men rollen erbjuder stora möjligheter att påverka och utveckla närliggande områden.


**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**

* Utveckla produktvision, mål och roadmap för ditt område
* Prioritera och förvalta backlog utifrån affärsvärde, kundnytta och tekniska förutsättningar
* Driva utveckling av digitala kundupplevelser och tjänster
* Samarbeta nära utvecklare, designers, analytiker och verksamheten
* Säkerställa att beslut och prioriteringar baseras på kundinsikter, data och affärsmål
* Hantera och koordinera många olika intressenter och perspektiv
* Identifiera möjligheter att förbättra kundupplevelse, självservice och digital försäljning
* Utforska nya arbetssätt och tekniska möjligheter som stärker kundupplevelsen och affären

**Olof beskriver sitt ledarskap:**  

"Jag leder med energi, tydlighet och ett starkt fokus på samarbete och resultat. För mig är det viktigt att skapa en tydlig riktning genom strategi, vision och mål, och samtidigt ge teamet förutsättningar och mandat att omsätta dem i handling. Jag vill bygga starka och högpresterande team där människor utvecklar varandra, delar kunskap och vågar utmana, testa och lära."


**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Du kan se fram emot att:**

* Vara en del av Tres digitala transformation
* Komma in i en organisation där mycket utvecklas och förändras
* Arbeta nära affär, teknik, analys och design
* Ha stor påverkan på prioriteringar och framtida lösningar
* Arbeta med engagerade kollegor i tvärfunktionella team
* Bidra till att utveckla framtidens digitala kundupplevelser

**Mer om dig**  

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av produktledning i en större organisation och som trivs i miljöer där kundbehov, affärsmål och teknisk utveckling möts. Du tycker om att skapa tydlighet i komplexa sammanhang och motiveras av att driva utveckling som gör verklig skillnad för både kunder och verksamhet.


**Vi tror att du:**


* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta som Product Owner, Product Manager eller i en liknande roll inom digital produktutveckling
* Har arbetat med roadmap, backlog och prioritering av digitala produkter eller tjänster
* Har erfarenhet av digital försäljning, självservice eller digitala kundupplevelser
* Är van att samarbeta med utvecklingsteam och andra specialistroller
* Bygger förtroende och skapar samsyn mellan olika intressenter
* Fattar beslut med hjälp av data, kundinsikter och affärsmål


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**

* Digital transformation
* Självservice eller digital försäljning
* Abonnemangsbaserade affärsmodeller
* Telekom
* AI-drivna arbetssätt

Som person är du driven, nyfiken och strukturerad. Du tar ansvar för dina leveranser, kommunicerar tydligt och trivs i en roll där du behöver skapa framdrift genom samarbete med andra.


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**

Vi tar emot ansökningar via den här annonsen och går igenom dem löpande. Du behöver inte skicka med ett personligt brev, bifoga ditt CV och besvara frågorna i samband med din ansökan.


Så här ser vägen till Tre ut: Vi börjar med ett urval, följt av tester och en kortare telefonintervju. Därefter får du träffa den rekryterande chefen i en första intervju, följt av en kompetensbaserad intervju med vår Talent Acquisition Partner. För slutkandidaten ingår även referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
* Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
* Hundzon & gym i 3huset
* Subventionerad lunch
* Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar
* Generösa bonusmodeller eller provisioner
**Om företaget**
----------------

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.



Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.



När du startar din resa på Tre finns det oändliga möjligheter att växa och utvecklas med oss.



**WE THINK LIKE CHALLENGERS** - I en föränderlig värld, är vi på Tre nyfikna och ständigt öppna för nya lösningar. På Tre anpassar vi vägen framåt allt eftersom vi provar och lär oss vad som funkar bäst.



**WE WORK LIKE CHAMPIONS** - På Tre gör vi alltid vårt bästa. Vi känner ägandeskap för vår uppgift, sätter tydliga mål och håller fokus på det som gör mest nytta för affären.  




**WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES** - På Tre är vi schyssta kollegor. Vi samarbetar med varandra över team och funktioner, vi bollar idéer, ger och tar emot feedback.

title: CTO
description:
**About Airmee**
----------------

**We've completed over 40 million deliveries, serving millions of consumers and some of the largest e-commerce retailers in the Nordics. As a leading home delivery provider in Sweden, we've grown by 50%+ annually and are approaching SEK 1 billion in revenue.**

**And we're just getting started. With a proven platform, growing market share and significant opportunities ahead, we're entering our next phase of growth.**

**We're large enough to operate at real scale, yet small enough for one leader to fundamentally change how the company works. We believe technology should remove complexity, not create it.**

**The Role**
------------

**We're looking for a CTO to lead the next chapter of our technology platform and turn engineering into a lasting competitive advantage.**

**This is a builder-operator role. You'll modernize a business-critical platform while keeping a fast-growing, high-volume operation running every day.**

**Our technology combines a PostgreSQL core, serverless services on AWS, web dashboards and native courier and customer apps. It powers route optimization, live tracking and dynamic ETAs across millions of deliveries.**

**Your challenge is to evolve this architecture into a reliable, scalable and increasingly automated platform, while driving engineering performance through clear priorities, ownership and disciplined execution.**

**Reporting directly to the CEO and serving on the Management Team, you'll have the mandate to shape our technology strategy, make critical architectural decisions and ensure technology delivers measurable business impact.**

**Your mission: enable Airmee to scale faster, without scaling complexity or compromising today's operations.**

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within this role you will:**

* **Modernise the platform without disrupting it — lead the decomposition of our central architecture into isolated, resilient building blocks, sequenced around peak season.**
* **Make reliability the default — a platform designed for 2x peak volume, with mature observability and real-time systems that hold up under load.**
* **Build a data platform the business trusts — clear ingestion, transformation and governance layers, and one version of the truth from operational dashboards to Board reporting.**
* **Make reliability and security the default — establish strong observability, engineering standards and security practices and certifications that scale with the business.**
* **Build an engineering organisation that absorbs change without losing speed — clear ownership, documentation, modular work and disciplined ways of pausing and restarting.**
* **Scale our advantage in AI and automation — build on years of AI-driven optimization to accelerate engineering productivity, automate operations and unlock new capabilities.**

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**You'll own:**

* **Technology strategy and architecture — set the technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and lead platform modernization while balancing long-term investments with business priorities.**
* **Engineering, Product and Data leadership — ensure teams deliver results with clear ownership, accountability, high standards and speed of execution.**
* **Platform reliability and performance — ensure our systems are scalable, secure, cost-efficient and reliable across business-critical operations.**
* **Product and technology delivery — turn business needs into scalable products and capabilities, with predictable delivery, high quality and speed.**
* **Security and compliance — establish security by design, robust engineering practices and accountability for regulatory requirements.**

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

**We're looking for a technically exceptional leader who loves building, scaling and operating technology.**

**Someone who sees technology as the operating system of the business, not a separate function. Who combines long-term architectural thinking with the urgency to deliver results today.**

**You probably recognize yourself in several of these:**

* **You've built and scaled business-critical platforms, ideally through significant architectural transitions while maintaining live operations.**
* **You have deep technical expertise and the judgment to challenge architectural decisions, without needing to make every decision yourself.**
* **You know how to drive performance and accountability across engineering teams, ensuring priorities translate into measurable results.**
* **You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution — comfortable discussing technology strategy with the Management team and diving into technical problems with engineers.**
* **You know how to prioritize ruthlessly, protect engineering focus and deliver at speed without compromising reliability.**
* **You believe great systems and strong teams outperform heroic individuals.**
* **You have a continuous improvement mindset, always looking for ways to develop yourself and your team, and see AI and automation as tools to accelerate progress.**
* **You understand that great engineering is measured by the business outcomes it enables, not technical sophistication alone.**

**Experience we're looking for**
--------------------------------

* **Proven experience as a Head of Engineering, VP Engineering or senior engineering leader in a high-growth, operationally intensive business where technology powers live, real-world operations.**
* **Demonstrated ability to modernize business-critical systems without disrupting daily operations, balancing long-term architectural improvements with reliability, execution and immediate business needs.**
* **Strong technical background with hands-on experience building, scaling and modernizing complex platforms.**
* **Track record of driving engineering performance and delivery through clear priorities, accountability and high standards.**
* **Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, scalability, observability and cost efficiency, ideally on AWS.**
* **Experience working across Product, Engineering and Data, translating business priorities into technology decisions and measurable outcomes.**
* **Experience with data platforms, real-time systems and optimization is a strong advantage.**
* **Fluent English. Swedish is a plus.**

**You understand that tomorrow's technology improvements cannot come at the expense of today's operations.**

**Why Airmee?**
---------------

**At Airmee, you'll join a company where:**

* **You'll shape the direction of the business, not just the technology behind it.**
* **You'll have real ownership over how the platform and the engineering organisation scale.**
* **You'll build the technical infrastructure behind our journey to SEK 1 billion in revenue—and beyond.**
* **You'll solve complex problems at real operational scale, working alongside an ambitious management team in a fast-growing, profitable company.**
* **Your work will leave a lasting impact on how Airmee operates for years to come.**

**If you're excited by building platforms and organisations that can grow faster without becoming more complex, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
DevSecOps Consultant Who are we? Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects since 2007 – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering.
  
  

We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Job description Join Amaris Consulting as a DevSecOps Consultant in Gothenburg and contribute to a strategic project for one of our clients in the automotive sector. Within a Cyber Security Expert Team, the role focuses on supporting development and platform teams with security expertise, governance, and practical DevSecOps practices across cloud, application, and platform environments. Your missions Provide operational security support to development and platform teams on security questions, findings, incidents, and risk assessments.
  
  

Support the integration of automated security controls, scanning, and policies into development lifecycles and CI/CD pipelines. Contribute to secure design and implementation across cloud environments, applications, and container-based platforms. Assist teams with vulnerability handling, third-party dependency management, and software supply chain security practices. Coach development and platform teams on practical security measures that support delivery speed and reliability.
  
  

Apply established security best practices, benchmarks, and governance standards across technical environments. Share knowledge within the Cyber Security Expert Team to improve ways of working and common practices. Contribute to the development of security standards, guidelines, and reusable approaches across the organization. Your profile Experience in application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, or security engineering within development or platform environments.
  
  

Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms and core services, including compute, identity, networking, logging, and monitoring. Experience with vulnerability management, secure development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and security automation. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent. Knowledge of container orchestration platforms, code scanning, artifact scanning, and dependency governance is a plus.
  
  

Familiarity with common security and compliance frameworks is a plus. Academic background in cybersecurity, computer science, software development, information systems, or a related field is appreciated. English fluent. Swedish is a plus.
  
  

Strong analytical and structured mindset, with the ability to work independently in complex technical environments. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment.
  
  

For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

title: Client Engineer (Data)
description:
**About Proxify**  

  

Proxify is a global network of vetted remote software, data and AI professionals. We help companies scale their tech teams with world-class talent, typically delivering the right match within two days.  

  

Only about 1% of the 20,000+ people who apply each month make it into the network. Clients get speed, quality and flexibility, with real technical experts guiding every step, and none of the admin burden or risk of traditional hiring.  

  

**About the role**  

  

Do you speak fluent data, from pipelines and warehouses to dashboards and models, and love the idea of turning that knowledge into the perfect team for a client? This is your chance to be the technical expert behind every data match we make.  

  

As a **Client Engineer (Data)**, you'll be part of our client teams. You'll be the technical voice in front of clients and the person who decides which data professionals are right for them.  

  

**Technical discovery**: Run discovery calls with clients to understand their data landscape: stack, architecture, data maturity, team setup and business goals. Turn what you learn into a sharp role profile with the right skills, seniority and scope.  

  

**Matching**: Search and shortlist Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists and ML Engineers from the Proxify network. Interview them to assess technical depth and fit with the client's context.  

  

**Candidate presentation**: Write clear, convincing pitches that explain why each candidate fits, and support the client through interviews and decisions.  

  

**Client advisory**: Act as a trusted technical advisor. Challenge requirements when needed, and help clients shape roles that will actually solve their data problems.  

  

**Collaboration**: Work closely with Client Managers and Account Managers to meet client needs, keep timelines tight and grow long-term partnerships.  

  

**Client focus**: Startups, scaleups and enterprise companies building or scaling their data, analytics and AI capabilities.  

  

**Why you'll love this opportunity at Proxify**  

  

Help companies close their data skill gaps and create job opportunities for data professionals worldwide.  

  

Stay close to the tech: see dozens of modern data stacks and talk shop with top engineers every week.  

  

️ Be part of a humble, supportive and tech-savvy team.  

  

Great opportunities for professional development and personal growth.  

  

️ Work in a truly international team across 39 countries, with occasional in-person meetups.  

  

**What you bring to be successful in this role**  

  

* 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Scientist or in a similar data role.

title: Data Science Manager – (Fake Review Detection)
description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!


We're a leading online reviews platform, free and open to all. Our mission is to be a universal symbol of trust. We are well on our way - but there's still an exciting journey ahead of us. Do you want to join us?

  

A core value proposition of Trustpilot is Trust. We work hard to ensure that our platform has real content from real people with real experiences. That means eliminating fraudulent reviews and sanctioning suspect behavior to keep our platform authentic. Our Trust Technology team aims to be an established name in the use of advanced technology to safeguard the integrity of online reviews. The Trust teams are composed of both Engineering and Data Science functions, where both are integral to achieving our goals.

  

We are looking for a skilled Data Science Manager to join the Trust team in our mission. You will lead two teams of passionate and dedicated professionals, including Data Scientists who research Trust-specific problems and design ML solutions for them, and Engineers who build and maintain scalable infrastructure to turn detections into outcomes. You and your team will work within a focus area to develop, deploy, and maintain innovative technology at scale, alongside a cross-functional team of product managers, ML engineers, and designers. You will have the opportunity to collaborate widely across the business including with those in our Legal, Platform Engineering, and Data Science teams within Consumer, B2B, and Commercial.



To thrive in this role, you bring a background in building and scaling complex systems with machine learning at their core. You are a seasoned Data Scientist who enjoys remaining hands-on across the end-to-end lifecycle—from initial concept to production delivery. Bridging data science and engineering comes naturally to you, supported by an adaptable, curious mindset. While not required, prior exposure to fraud detection or online platform integrity is a great plus.


**What you'll be doing:**


* Lead and empower a team of Data Scientists and Engineers within the Trust context, focused on detection of fake reviews.
* Own the delivery of key initiatives and balance delivery with ambitious research goals and sustainable engineering practices.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence and actively support the development of your team members.
* Define, prioritise, and support the implementation of deliverables that achieve our Trust OKRs.
* Facilitate scoping, estimation, and planning of work in collaboration with the cross-functional teams.
* Build strong relationships with our Trust stakeholders and other teams.
* Communicate issues, risks, and dependencies with stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Trust Tech leadership to engage, develop and retain talent.
* Build a positive and safe working environment based on transparency, accountability, and trust.


**Who you are:**


* Experienced in a complex technical domain (such as fraud detection, healthcare ML, computer vision, autonomous systems, or large-scale LLM deployment), with a natural curiosity to immerse yourself in our field.
* Experience with delivering scalable systems with multiple connected services, and designing solutions involving ML/AI components. Experience with graphs and graph-based ML is a significant advantage. Other relevant experience includes: high-volume live inference, ML training / deep learning on cloud infrastructure on large datasets, training with mixed-quality labels for production use cases, optimizing ML models for low false-positive tolerance, fine-tuning language models on custom datasets.
* Experience managing a team of data scientists with a high delivery velocity. Ability to handle operational responsibility for high-impact production services, including incident management and recovery, maintenance, and monitoring of systems.
* As the role involves managing engineers, you've ideally managed cross-functional teams before or worked closely with engineering functions and understand how to run delivery of projects for engineering-heavy solutions.
* Experienced with cloud services, particularly GCP.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical experience and advanced knowledge of ML/AI. You'll be expected to work closely with the team and part of your time will be reserved for hands-on work so you can continue to stay current with new approaches and help to unblock the team.
* Experience coaching, mentoring, and growing individuals and teams.
* Experience building relationships with stakeholders in a collaborative setting.
* Happy to work in a dynamic environment with an informal and friendly working culture. We're often collaborating in the office and expect to see you in person several times a week.
* Enthusiastic about the mission of Trust and about empowering people on your team to be at their best.


**What's in it for you:**


* A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
* Competitive compensation package + bonus
* 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)
* Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
* Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
* Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
* Paid parental leave
* Central office with a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It's complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
* Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
* Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms
* Employee discounts to restaurants and shops
* Tailored leadership development program consisting of workshops, coaching opportunities, and structured feedback mechanisms to enable world-class leadership


#LI-MG1

**About us**



Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.



Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we're headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.



We're driven by connection. It's at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it's built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we're proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.



Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We're a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you're ready to grow, let's go.


**Join us at the heart of trust.**


*Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.*

Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our* *Privacy Policy.*

description:

A job at IKEA is so much more than home furnishings. Together, we work to make a better everyday life for the many. It's the perfect fit if you want to contribute, grow, and share. Join the team and start a better life for yourself."
