Candidate profile (title) Why we will love you
Candidate profile (text) - Default language You are passionate about technology, security and innovation, and motivated by turning architectural direction into meaningful business outcomes. You combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and can make complex security topics understandable and actionable for a broad range of stakeholders.
  

  

You have a product- and customer-centric mindset and understand that security architecture must enable, rather than slow down, digital innovation. You are comfortable working in an environment of continuous change, balancing long-term architectural direction with the needs of product teams and modern engineering practices. You enjoy working independently while building strong partnerships across technology, business, risk and security functions. Above all, you share and live the IKEA culture and values.
  

  

To be successful in this role, you have extensive experience in cyber security, enterprise architecture, technology architecture, computer science or a related field. You have led or significantly contributed to enterprise-wide security architecture transformation in a complex, global organisation ideally within retail, digital commerce or another large-scale omnichannel environment.
  

  

We believe you have significant experience in security, architecture, engineering or technology leadership roles, including experience designing secure, resilient and scalable distributed systems. You have worked with senior leaders to translate business priorities, technology strategy, regulatory expectations and cyber risk into clear architecture direction, investment priorities and practical guardrails.
  

  

You bring a strategic, holistic and outcome-led mindset, with the ability to influence change across a diverse organisation.
Key responsibilities (title) Your responsibilities
Key responsibilities (text) As an Enterprise Architect, Security, you are part of the Enterprise Architecture leadership team and play a key role in shaping the security, privacy and trust for the Ingka’s digital landscape. You provide strategic direction, principles, standards and architecture guardrails that enable secure, resilient and trusted digital products, platforms and services.
  

  

You will lead and evolve enterprise-wide Security Architecture, connecting business ambitions, cyber risk, technology strategy and modern engineering practices. You will help ensure security is embedded by design across Ingka’s digital ecosystem from cloud platforms and identity services to data, AI, applications and cyber defence capabilities.
  

  

You will work closely with Cyber Security, Privacy, Digital Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Data & AI, Product and Engineering leaders to enable secure innovation at scale. Your decisions will serve the needs of Ingka as a whole, rather than optimising for individual domains or technologies.
  

  

In this role, you will
  

* Define and evolve Ingka’s Security Architecture, target state and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities, technology strategy and cyber risk appetite.
* Establish reusable security principles, standards and reference architectures across Zero Trust, identity and access management, cloud and SaaS security, data protection, application and platform security, and cyber defence.
* Drive secure-by-design and secure-by-default practices by translating security, privacy and compliance requirements into practical guardrails, patterns and automated controls for product, platform and engineering teams.
* Guide the development of Ingka’s modern Cyber Defence Architecture, strengthening capabilities for prevention, detection, response, recovery, security observability and automation.
* Shape and evolve the AI Security Architecture together with Security, Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI, Privacy and Risk teams, enabling the secure and responsible adoption of AI across Ingka.
* Act as a subject matter expert on AI security, advising stakeholders on AI-related risks, governance, controls, data protection, secure architecture patterns and emerging threats.
* Identify and drive the security capabilities, products and services needed to enable secure AI adoption, modern engineering practices and scalable digital innovation.
* Lead resolution of complex cross-domain security architecture challenges, including identity boundaries, privileged access, cloud and workload protection, network segmentation and shared security services.
* Represent the CISO organisation and broader security interests in architecture governance, strategic initiatives and investment decisions.
* Partner with Cyber Security & Privacy, Digital Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Data & AI, Product and Engineering leaders to ensure security architecture enables resilient, compliant and trusted digital products and services.

  

You bring the following capabilities and experience
  

* Ability to align senior stakeholders, including executive and board-level audiences, around a common security vision, architecture direction and prioritised outcomes.
* Ability to define and evolve strategic security architecture direction, manage complex trade-offs, and balance cyber risk reduction with business value, speed, usability, resilience and cost.
* Strong knowledge of modern security architecture across cloud, hybrid and SaaS environments, including identity and access management, data security, application security, platform security, network security and cyber defence.
* Experience designing and evolving security capabilities for cloud-native, API-led, distributed and event-driven technology landscapes.
* Deep understanding of Zero Trust principles and the ability to translate these into scalable architecture patterns, guardrails and engineering practices.
* Extensive experience in identity and access management, including authentication, authorisation, privileged access, machine identities, secrets management and certificate lifecycle management.
* Experience with security observability, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, security automation and continuous control monitoring.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps, software delivery, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, automated security testing, policy-as-code and platform engineering.
* Experience developing enterprise architecture principles, target architectures, reference architectures, standards and roadmaps that can be adopted across multiple domains and product teams.
* Knowledge of data and AI security, including the secure adoption of AI services, model and data protection, access controls, third-party AI risk, AI governance and emerging AI-related threats.
* Ability to solve complex, cross-domain architecture challenges and guide technology transformation that enables new digital opportunities and business models.
* A strong understanding of enterprise architecture and the ability to connect security architecture decisions with business strategy, digital products, platforms and the wider technology landscape.
* Experience leading, coaching and developing architecture or engineering teams, while influencing stakeholders beyond direct reporting lines.

  

You are a collaborative and trusted leader who can engage a diverse set of stakeholders and create clarity in complex situations. You are attentive to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture, actively develop your own knowledge and capabilities, and champion ways of working that improve speed, quality and security. You are curious about emerging technologies and can adapt your approach as business priorities, threats and technology evolve.

title: Receptionist Scandic Borlänge, Varannan helg (december-mars).
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 7 december 2026
* Borlänge
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Scandic Borlänge är ett familjärt hotell mitt i city, nära centralstationen och shoppingen på Norra Backa. Här kan våra gäster njuta av god mat i vår restaurang, varva ner i vår inomhuspool eller bara umgås i vår lobby.


På hotellet lägger vi stor vikt vid att erbjuda våra medarbetare en bra arbetsmiljö – ett gott ledarskap i en varm och familjär atmosfär. Vi tar inte bara väl hand om våra gäster, vi tar alltid hand om varandra. Vi jobbar tillsammans, sida vid sida, för att nå vårt gemensamma mål- att skapa hotellupplevelser i absolut världsklass för våra gäster.


**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Borlänge.**


Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!


Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**


Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**


För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**


Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning varannan helg under perioden december–mars.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!


Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

**Vill du leda nästa steg i Tres digitala utveckling?**

På Tre befinner vi oss mitt i en spännande förändringsresa där vi utvecklar våra digitala kanaler, arbetssätt och kundupplevelser för framtiden. Nu söker vi en **E-commerce & Self-service Manager** som vill vara med och driva den utvecklingen framåt.


Här får du möjlighet att kombinera ledarskap, affärsutveckling och digital transformation i en roll med stort inflytande över hur vi arbetar, prioriterar och utvecklar våra digitala kundupplevelser framåt.


**Om rollen**
  

Som E-commerce & Self-service Manager ansvarar du för utvecklingen av några av Tres viktigaste digitala kund- och försäljningskanaler. Du leder ett team bestående av Product Owners och Designers och skapar förutsättningarna för att teamet ska lyckas, både idag och på längre sikt.


Du blir en del av vårt Online Consumer Market-team och arbetar nära IT, kommersiella funktioner och andra delar av verksamheten för att säkerställa att vi fokuserar på det som skapar störst värde för kunderna och affären.


Rollen kombinerar ledarskap, affärsutveckling och strategisk utveckling. Vi söker dig som tycker om att skapa struktur där det saknas, sätta riktning i förändring och omsätta idéer till konkreta resultat.


**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**

* Leda, coacha och utveckla ett team av Product Owners och Designers
* Skapa tydlig riktning, struktur och prioriteringar för teamets arbete
* Driva utvecklingen av digital försäljning, kundupplevelse och självservice
* Säkerställa effektiv samverkan mellan affär, IT och andra delar av organisationen
* Ansvara för mål, KPI:er och uppföljning inom området
* Driva förändrings- och transformationsinitiativ från idé till genomförande
* Utveckla arbetssätt, processer och samarbetsformer
* Stötta teamet i komplexa frågeställningar och bidra med vägledning när nya arbetssätt eller lösningar behöver etableras

**Olof beskriver sitt ledarskap**  

"Jag leder med energi, tydlighet och ett starkt fokus på samarbete och resultat. För mig är det viktigt att skapa en tydlig riktning genom strategi, vision och mål, och samtidigt ge teamet förutsättningar och mandat att omsätta dem i handling. Jag vill bygga starka och högpresterande team där människor utvecklar varandra, delar kunskap och vågar utmana, testa och lära."


**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*
Henrik Sundvall
Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Du kan se fram emot att:**

* Vara en del av Tres digitala transformation
* Komma in i ett skede där du har möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt, prioriteringar och framtida lösningar
* Arbeta nära affär, teknik, analys och design
* Ha stor påverkan på prioriteringar, arbetssätt och framtida lösningar
* Bidra till att utveckla framtidens digitala kundupplevelser

**Mer om dig**  

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av ledarskap inom digital utveckling och som trivs i miljöer där affär, teknik och kundupplevelse möts. Du tycker om att utveckla både människor och verksamhet och har förmågan att skapa engagemang och framdrift när förutsättningarna förändras.


**Vi tror att du:**


* Har flera års erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla medarbetare inom digital utveckling, produktorganisation eller närliggande område
* Har drivit förändrings- eller transformationsinitiativ där affär, teknik och flera intressenter varit involverade
* Har erfarenhet av digital försäljning, e-handel eller digital självservice
* Är van att skapa struktur, prioriteringar och tydliga arbetssätt
* Fattar beslut med hjälp av data, kundinsikter och affärsmål
* Kan omsätta strategi och långsiktig riktning till konkreta resultat


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**

* Digital försäljning eller e-handel
* Självserviceplattformar och digitala kundresor
* Produktorganisationer med Product Owners och designers
* Telekom
* Nordiskt eller internationellt samarbete
* AI-drivna arbetssätt

Som ledare bygger du förtroende genom tydlig kommunikation, samarbete och ett starkt fokus på resultat. Du får människor att arbeta mot gemensamma mål och skapar framdrift även när förändringstakten är hög.  

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**

Vi tar emot ansökningar via den här annonsen och går igenom dem löpande. Du behöver inte skicka med ett personligt brev, bifoga ditt CV och besvara frågorna i samband med din ansökan.


Så här ser vägen till Tre ut: Vi börjar med ett urval, följt av tester och en kortare telefonintervju. Därefter får du träffa den rekryterande chefen i en första intervju, följt av en kompetensbaserad intervju med vår Talent Acquisition Partner. För slutkandidaten ingår även referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll.


**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrarlön, pension & försäkringar enligt kollektivavtal
* Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
* Hundzon & gym i 3huset
* Subventionerad lunch
* Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar
* Generösa bonusmodeller eller provisioner

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
**About Gelato**


Gelato runs the world’s largest network for on-demand production of customized products, from t-shirts and wall art to mugs, books and cards. We’re an AI-first, cloud-native platform with zero physical assets:

* **GelatoCreate** connects e-commerce businesses to 250+ partners across 32 countries, reaching over 5 billion people in under 72 hours.
* **GelatoConnect**, our AI-driven print production OS, runs producers’ operations end to end, covering procurement, workflow and logistics.
* **Optimalprint**, where Gelato began, is our consumer brand in 20+ markets, helping millions of customers create personalised cards, wall art and gifts, online and through its app.


Together they sit between thousands of merchants, our production partners and millions of customers. Every order carries someone’s data, designs and brand.

**AI at the Core**


We are not just early adopters of AI — we’re AI-native builders, and security is no exception.

* **AI is how we work.** Engineers use LLMs for code generation, testing and documentation, and autonomous agents drive platform resilience, observability, cost control and internal workflow automation. Our security team works the same way, with LLMs and agents handling alert triage, threat summaries, runbooks and response orchestration.
* **AI is also what we protect.** AI agents already run inside GelatoConnect and our core platform. They map product catalogues, validate file uploads, and even write and deploy integration code. Agents with that kind of reach raise new questions about tool permissions, prompt injection and data flows, and you’ll make sure what they build is secure without slowing our teams down.

**The Role**


This isn’t an analyst role where you watch dashboards and send findings back. Our engineers now ship many times more than they used to with AI, so reviewing their work by hand doesn’t scale. You’ll build the agents and automation that review alongside them, make sure the agents engineering builds are secure too, and act as the bridge between information security and engineering.


You’ll join a small information security team, reporting to [our Head of Information Security], and work across application security, cloud and identity, and detection and response. You don’t need to be an expert in all of it. **If you’re strong in a few of these areas and keen to grow into the rest, we’ll help you get there.**

**What You’ll Do**

* **Automate with AI:** build and operate agents for code and change review, alert triage, finding validation, investigation summaries and routing to owners. You’ll connect them safely to internal systems with least privilege, audit logs and human approval for risky actions. You’ll measure them honestly (accuracy, false-positive rate, time saved, what a human had to correct) and retire the ones that don’t earn their keep.
* **Secure the SDLC:** own SAST, SCA, secret, container and IaC scanning, tuned so engineers trust the signal. Threat-model new services and AI features early, including the agents engineering builds, and build paved-road defaults (libraries, templates, CI checks) so common vulnerability classes become hard to introduce.
* **Secure Cloud and Identity:** assess and audit cloud and container platform security, including least-privilege IAM, preventative guardrails, cluster hardening, runtime detection and the infrastructure as code behind it. Our Platform team owns implementation. You’ll also manage identity provider roles, clients and access reviews, and keep authentication and authorisation consistent across services.
* **Detect and Respond:** monitor through our SIEM, scan our attack surface, and lead incidents end to end: containment, investigation, communication, and a blameless write-up whose fixes actually land. Write response playbooks that agents run for the routine steps and that escalate to a person, with the work already done, when judgement is needed. Hunt proactively, feed what you find back into detections and guardrails, and share an on-call rotation.
* **Partner with Engineering:** explain risk plainly to engineers, product and leadership, and give prioritised, concrete fixes rather than a list of findings. Make security decisions visible by writing down the reasoning, the trade-off, and what we chose not to do.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years in security engineering, AppSec, cloud security or incident response
* An AI-native way of working: hands-on experience building with LLMs (agents, tool calling, RAG or MCP), knowing where they fail, and using AI tools every day. **This is a hard requirement.**
* Hands-on experience securing a major public cloud (AWS preferred, but Azure or GCP works too), Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, plus solid web, API, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC and IAM fundamentals
* Solid foundations in application security, the secure SDLC and incident response, with deep expertise in some of them
* Production-quality code in Python, Go or TypeScript, and a habit of automating over repeating
* The ability to earn engineers’ trust with plain explanations, practical fixes and pragmatic trade-offs
* Fluent written and spoken English

**Nice to Have**

* Offensive security: pentesting, bug bounty, CTFs or published research
* AI red-teaming or OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* Threat hunting, forensics or malware analysis
* Hands-on experience with SIEM and SOAR / workflow automation platforms
* Experience running an open-source identity provider, Kubernetes runtime security or policy-as-code
* OSCP, OSWE, GCIH or cloud security certifications (a plus, never a requirement)

**What it's like to work at Gelato**


We are a customer-obsessed team with the ambition to change the world by connecting technology to the printing industry and making it much more sustainable. Everyone who joins our team must feel genuinely intrigued and motivated by our mission. We expect a lot. We are a driven team with big goals, so we seek individuals who are genuinely passionate about their work and possess an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is unique and we live by our values, so it's worth learning more about our culture and how we work before presenting your application.


At Gelato, we pride ourselves on our global presence with 11 offices worldwide, fostering a dynamic and diverse work environment. Rooted in a culture that values collaboration, creativity, and camaraderie, we actively cultivate a company culture that thrives on shared experiences. We encourage team members to embrace this culture by working from our office spaces at least three days a week, allowing for meaningful connections and collective growth.


Lastly, we ask that you please upload your **CV in English**, regardless of which country you are applying from.

 **Candidate Information**


As part of our commitment to a transparent recruitment process, please be aware that following acceptance of an offer of employment with Gelato, you will be asked to complete a background check conducted by a third-party provider.

title: Kommunikatör
description:
Uddevalla – en plats för hela livet Välkommen att bli en del av vår växande kommun - och att tillsammans med oss arbeta för att ge våra kommuninvånare ännu bättre service. Vi erbjuder en attraktiv arbetsplats som ger dig stora möjligheter att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vårt mål är att alla ska kunna trivas och växa - under ett helt yrkesliv. Vi vill också utvecklas som arbetsgivare och arbetar aktivt för att på bästa sätt ta till vara på din kunskap och ditt engagemang. Vi uppskattar och uppmuntrar till medskapande från alla. Uddevalla kommun är en vacker plats vid havet i hjärtat av Bohuslän. Vi tror på ett öppet och positivt samspel mellan kommun, utbildning, näringsliv och kultur. Vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas hos oss!

### **Om arbetsplatsen**


Nu behöver vi förstärka vår kommunikationsavdelning med ytterligare en stjärna! Vi söker efter en erfaren kommunikatör som letar efter ett omväxlande och utvecklande arbetet inom kommunikation.


Vad erbjuder vi?


Vi erbjuder ett roligt, meningsfullt och varierande arbete med positiva, stöttande och härliga kollegor. Samt en möjlighet att vara en stor del i vårt uppdrag att utveckla vår kommunikation och ge de som bor, vistas och verkar i Uddevalla kommun relevant och tydlig information.

### **Arbetsuppgifter**


Tillsammans med dina kollegor kommer du vara en del av det dagliga arbetet med kommunens externa och interna kommunikation, i alla våra kanaler. Ni arbetar med att identifiera, paketera och presentera information och nyheter och stärka bilden av Uddevalla som en attraktiv och framtidsinriktad kommun.  

  

Det kan till exempel innebära att skriva nyhets- och informationstexter, fotografera, skapa filmer, uppdatera våra hemsidor, arbeta med event och kampanjer samt kommunikationsplanering och -rådgivning, internt och externt. Vi hjälps åt för att skapa så bra intern och extern kommunikation som möjligt för våra medborgare och kollegor!  

  

Du kommer arbeta mot och med vår Kultur och fritidsförvaltning, fungera som ett stöd för i kommunikativa frågor och informera våra medborgare, medarbetare, företag, besökare och media om allt bra kommunen gör.

* Ansvara för förvaltningens del av våra webbsidor, sociala medier samt samordna insatser för den externa kommunikationen över hela förvaltningen.
* Stödja förvaltningen med kommunikationsplanering och kommunikationsstrategier
* Vara en aktiv del i utvecklandet av kommunens interna och externa kommunikation
* Säkerställa att rutiner, lagar och regler följs
* Bidra till kunskapsuppbyggnad inom organisationen för att stärka kommunens motståndskraft mot desinformation, ryktesspridning och försök till påverkan
* Skapa innehåll till våra kommunikationskanaler, till exempel textförfattande, bild- och  

videoredigering

### **Vem söker vi**


Vi tror att du är:

* Erfaren inom kommunikation och kommunikationsplanering.
* Ambitiös och vill vara med och påverka – både på arbetsplatsen och i samhället i stort
* Har ett omvärldsintresse och en naturlig nyfikenhet på politik, samhälle och stadsutveckling
* Är trygg i en rådgivande roll
* Är en duktig skribent och klarar av att skriva och målgruppsanpassa olika typer av text
* Är noggrann, självgående, kreativ och idérik
* Är en strategisk person som tycker om att motivera och inspirera andra
* Är en lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra och inte har några problem att hjälpa till där det behövs

### **Kvalifikationer**

* Högskoleexamen inom strategisk kommunikation eller liknande utbildning/erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdigt
* Kunskap och erfarenhet av att arbeta inom kommunikation och marknadsföring
* Kunskap och erfarenhet av strategisk kommunikation och kommunikationsplanering
* Förmåga att anpassa innehåll efter målgrupp och plattform
* Kunskap om lagar och regler kopplade till kommunikation, till exempel Dataskyddsförodningen (GDPR), Lagen om tillgänglighet till digital offentlig service, Upphovsrätt
* Kunskap och erfarenhet av att arbeta med program inom Adobe Creative Cloud och Office-paketet
* Kunskap och erfarenhet av webbpubliceringsverktyg t.ex. Sitevision


Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en politiskt styrd organisation är en fördel men vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.


Anställning sker under förutsättning att erforderliga beslut fattas. För tjänster där arbetet innebär direkt och regelbunden kontakt med barn och ungdomar, samt för verksamhet inom LSS, vård- och omsorg, hälso-och sjukvård, psykiatrisk vård och missbruksvård, ska giltigt utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister visas upp alternativt lämnas in före anställning. Tänk på att det kan ta tid att få utdraget så beställ det i god tid för att rekryteringsprocessen inte ska fördröjas. När du söker ett jobb hos oss sparas din ansökan. Det beror på att vi är en offentlig verksamhet. Din ansökan blir en allmän handling när vi har mottagit den. Det innebär att ansökningshandlingar och information om vem som sökt en tjänst kan begäras ut av den som vill. Om du har skyddad identitet ska du inte göra din ansökan digitalt utan kontakta den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen. För dig som inte är medborgare inom EU/EES-området krävs arbetstillstånd, detta gäller inte dig som har permanent uppehållstillstånd. Arbetstillståndet ska uppvisas vid intervjutillfället. I länken nedan finns samlad information kring de viktigaste förmånerna som finns i kollektivavtalet som vi har i Uddevalla kommun. Informationen handlar om bland annat semester, lön och ersättningar, föräldraledighet, försäkringar, kompetensutveckling och pension.Säg hej till ditt kollektivavtal 2024För löneintervall hänvisar vi till vår hemsida: Lönestatistik - Uddevalla kommunOm löneintervall saknas för den aktuella tjänsten hänvisas du att kontakta ansvarig chef enligt annonsen. Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
description:
Senior Test Automation Engineer – Financial Crime Prevention Vi söker en erfaren Senior Test Automation Engineer till SEB område Financial Crime Prevention. Uppdraget fokuserar på kvalitetssäkring och testautomation av avancerade plattformar och detekteringslösningar för att förebygga finansiell brottslighet. Du kommer att arbeta i en modern cloud-native miljö med dataplattformar, regelbaserade detekteringsmotorer, API, integrationer och realtidsflöden på Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med utvecklare, Business Analysts, kravanalytiker och arkitekter för att säkerställa kvalitet genom hela utvecklingsprocessen.
  
  

Om uppdraget Uppdraget ingår i Financial Crime Prevention där du får en central roll i att utveckla och förbättra teststrategier, automatiserade tester och kvalitetssäkringsprocesser. Du arbetar hands-on med testautomation, datatestning och validering av komplex affärslogik. En viktig del av uppdraget är även att tillämpa AI-assisterad och agentbaserad testning för att effektivisera testprocesser och vidareutveckla moderna arbetssätt inom Quality Engineering. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Designa, utveckla och underhålla automatiserade tester med Python och/eller Java.
  
  

Utveckla och förbättra testautomationsramverk och teststrategier. Tillämpa AI-assisterad och agentbaserad testning inom testdesign, testgenerering, exekvering och analys. Testa dataplattformar, datapipelines, ETL-processer, datakvalitet och datatransformationer inom GCP. Validera regelbaserade detekteringsmotorer och komplex affärslogik.
  
  

Testa API, integrationer och realtidsflöden i distribuerade system. Utveckla och underhålla regressionstester samt integrations- och end-to-end-tester. Integrera automatiserade tester i CI/CD-pipelines och utvecklingsflöden. Säkerställa att AI-genererade testresultat är validerade, spårbara och reproducerbara.
  
  

Identifiera kvalitetsrisker och samarbeta med teamet för att säkerställa robusta tekniska lösningar. Kvalifikationer – skallkrav Vi söker dig som har: Minst 8–10 års relevant erfarenhet inom testautomation, teknisk testning eller Quality Engineering. Gedigen erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera testautomationslösningar och ramverk. Mycket goda programmeringskunskaper i Python och/eller Java samt goda SQL-kunskaper.
  
  

Praktisk erfarenhet av AI-assisterad eller agentbaserad testning inom mjukvarutestningens livscykel. Erfarenhet av Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Gedigen erfarenhet av datatestning, ETL-processer och datakvalitet. Erfarenhet av testning av regelbaserade system, beslutsmotorer eller komplex affärslogik.
  
  

God förståelse för API, systemintegrationer, CI/CD och end-to-end-testning. Stark analytisk förmåga och förståelse för sambandet mellan data, teknik, verksamhetskrav och kontroller. Förmåga att självständigt driva testarbete och ta ansvar för leveranser i agila, tvärfunktionella team. God kommunikativ förmåga och vana av teknisk dokumentation.
  
  

Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Meriterande Erfarenhet från bank- och finanssektorn, Financial Crime Prevention, transaktionsövervakning, compliance eller annan reglerad verksamhet. Erfarenhet av BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub och/eller Composer inom GCP. Erfarenhet av AI-baserade utvecklings- och testverktyg.
  
  

ISTQB-certifiering eller motsvarande. Google Cloud-certifiering. Certifiering inom kravhantering, exempelvis REQB eller motsvarande. Personliga egenskaper Du är analytisk, strukturerad och självgående med ett starkt kvalitetsfokus.
  
  

Du har ett proaktivt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt, trivs i komplexa tekniska miljöer och har förmåga att samarbeta effektivt med både verksamhet och tekniska team. Du är nyfiken på nya teknologier och drivs av att kontinuerligt utveckla testprocesser och arbetssätt. Vi erbjuder 32 dagars semester Tjänstepension Friskvårdsbidrag Möjligheter till kompetensutveckling Ett stöttande och engagerat team Vi samarbetar även med frilansare och underkonsulter med eget bolag. title: Analytics/ML Engineer - Data Team
description:
10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.


With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.


Founded in 2022, and with 800+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.

**About the role:**  

  

You'll join Aira's central data team, working across the entire customer journey, from acquisition and sales to technical design, installation and live heat pump data. Our work has a direct impact on the tools and processes used across Aira.


We're moving from traditional BI towards self-service analytics, where teams can explore data and answer questions themselves. This will allow us to spend less time on ad hoc reporting and more time solving complex problems using statistics, optimisation and machine learning.


The work is varied. One day you might build data models and metrics for self-service analytics, the next you might use machine learning, statistical modelling or thermodynamics to improve how we design and sell our products.


We’re looking for someone who enjoys both sides of that spectrum: strong analytics engineering and quantitative problem solving, combined with a keen business mindset.

 **What you’ll be doing:**

* Build and maintain data models and metrics using SQL and dbt.
* Work with Product teams to define KPIs, track performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Develop the semantic layer that powers self-service analytics across Aira.
* Use statistics, experimentation, optimisation and machine learning to improve our products and processes.
* Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude in your day-to-day work.
 **What you’ll bring to the role:**

* 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data science, machine learning or a similar quantitative role.
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
* Experience with data transformation and dimensional data modelling.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to tackle problems that don't have an obvious solution.
* An interest in understanding the business and working closely with Product teams to improve how things work.
 **Bonus:**

* A strong quantitative background in mathematics, physics, engineering, statistics or a related field.
* Experience developing or deploying machine learning models.
* Experience with statistical modelling, experimentation or causal analysis.
* Experience working with optimisation problems, physical models or time-series/telemetry data.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as GCP, AWS or Azure.
 **What you can expect:**

* Work close to the decisions that shape Aira's customer journey, where your insights can translate directly into changes to our products and processes.
* Help move Aira from traditional BI towards self-service analytics, creating more room for advanced modelling and ML.
* Work on a broad range of problems spanning analytics engineering, statistics, data science, machine learning and real-world physical systems.
* Collaborate closely with Product teams and diverse teams across our international markets.
* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
 **What is in it for you?**

* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**

  

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.  



  

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.  



  

Job Title: Senior Customer Success Manager
  

Department & Team: Customer Success – North
  

Reports to: Director, Customer Success – North  

  



**Summary**
-----------

Genesys is looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to lead strategic relationships with enterprise customers across the North region.


The Senior CSM is a trusted advisor and customer orchestrator, connecting customer priorities with Genesys capabilities to deliver measurable value, accelerate adoption and AI transformation, protect retention, and create sustainable growth.


Success in this role is defined not only by what you achieve, but how you achieve it. You will lead with curiosity, accountability and transparency; build trust across customers, partners and Genesys teams; help others grow; and use AI to shift your own time toward higher-value customer engagement.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own customer success strategy for a portfolio of strategic and high-value customers, developing Experience Orchestration Plans (EOPs) and Customer Success Plans (CSPs) aligned to business priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Build trusted executive relationships, elevating conversations from operational topics toward business value, CX strategy, AI transformation and long-term partnership.
* Drive value realization and adoption, using customer, adoption and health insights to proactively identify risks, opportunities and actions that improve business outcomes.
* Guide AI transformation, helping customers identify relevant use cases, assess maturity and progress from initial adoption toward scaled AI-powered experience orchestration.
* Orchestrate One Genesys, aligning Sales, Professional Services, TAMs, CX Advisory, Product, Renewals, Education and other teams around one customer strategy and shared outcomes.
* Collaborate effectively with partners, developing shared success plans and maintaining appropriate visibility into customer health, adoption, executive priorities and opportunities in partner-led accounts.
* Protect and grow the customer relationship, identifying renewal risks early while proactively surfacing expansion opportunities across Genesys Cloud, AI, Professional Services and Education.
* Lead strategic customer governance, including Executive Business Reviews and transformation discussions focused on outcomes, value realized, priorities and future opportunities.
* Develop customer advocacy, identifying opportunities for references, customer stories, events, speaking engagements and broader participation in the Genesys community.
* Elevate the people around you, coaching and mentoring colleagues, sharing customer lessons and best practices, providing constructive feedback and helping create an environment of trust, psychological safety and continuous learning.
* Work AI-first, using AI to research customers and industries, synthesize signals, identify risks and opportunities, prepare executive engagements and automate lower-value work. Apply sound judgment to AI outputs and share effective AI practices with the broader team.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

* Significant experience in Customer Success, strategic account management, consulting or another enterprise SaaS customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders and influence business and transformation decisions.
* Strong understanding of SaaS Customer Success, including adoption, value realization, customer health, retention, expansion and lifecycle management.
* Strong commercial mindset with experience identifying growth opportunities and partnering effectively with Sales.
* Ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without formal authority.
* Experience working in partner-led or channel-based environments, balancing strong partner collaboration with appropriate customer intimacy.
* Ability to translate technology and AI capabilities into business outcomes and compelling executive narratives.
* Practical AI literacy and experience using generative AI and digital tools to improve research, analysis, communication, prioritization and productivity.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to turn customer data and signals into insights, recommendations and actions.
* Excellent communication, facilitation and executive storytelling skills.
* Demonstrated ownership, learning agility and sound judgment, with the ability to prioritize impact over activity and operate independently in complex environments.
* Ability and willingness to coach others, share expertise and contribute to the success and development of the broader team.

**Desirable Skills**
--------------------

description:
**About Us**



Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by eight Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Cape Town, Johannesburg and Paris .

  

With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, **Integrity360** delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.

  

At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you

 **The Role**


**Join us as a Senior Network Security Consultant / Architect**



We are looking for an experienced **Network Security Consultant / Architect** who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working closely with customers to build secure, resilient network environments.

  

This is not a purely architectural role. We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between **architecture, design and hands-on implementation**, whether that means designing a new network security architecture, migrating firewall environments or troubleshooting a complex customer issue.

  

You will work across different customer environments and be trusted to take technical ownership, advise stakeholders and turn requirements into solutions that work in practice.

 **What you’ll be doing**



Depending on the customer and assignment, you will:


* Design and implement secure enterprise network architectures
* Work hands-on with **Cisco Networks, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet/FortiGate and related security technologies**
* Design and perform firewall migrations and security improvements
* Implement network segmentation and micro-segmentation
* Support **OT network segmentation and security**
* Design Zero Trust network architectures
* Work with routing, switching, VPN and secure remote access
* Troubleshoot complex network and security issues
* Design hybrid and cloud-connected network environments
* Perform network hardening and security improvements
* Produce clear technical designs and documentation
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers


In short, you should be comfortable taking an engagement from:


**Requirements**  **Architecture**  **Design**  **Implementation**  **Troubleshooting**  **Documentation**

 **What we’re looking for**



We believe you have several years of experience within enterprise networking and network security, ideally **7+ years**, and that you are comfortable working independently in complex customer environments.



You have strong experience in several of the following:


* Palo Alto Networks, including NGFW, Panorama and VPN
* Fortinet / FortiGate
* Enterprise network security
* Firewall architecture, implementation and migration
* Network segmentation and micro-segmentation
* Routing and switching
* VPN and remote access
* Network troubleshooting and performance
* Security architecture and solution design
* Network hardening
* Hybrid/cloud networking

  


**Nice to have**



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:


* Zscaler, SASE or SSE
* Prisma Access
* Microsoft Azure networking and security
* AWS networking and security
* Cisco networking
* F5
* SD-WAN
* OT security
* Regulated or critical infrastructure environments

  



Certifications such as **PCNSE, Fortinet certifications, CCNP/CCIE Security, Azure or AWS certifications** are valuable, but practical experience and technical depth matter most.

 **The kind of person we think will thrive**



You enjoy being close to the technology and solving difficult problems, but you can also step back, understand the bigger picture and explain your recommendations to customers.



You don't want to choose between being an engineer and an architect. **You want to be able to do both.**



If that sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

We are hiring **Senior Test Automation Engineer** for **Sweden.**


**Job Summary:**


We are looking for an experienced **Senior Test Automation Engineer** will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime, within an environment of cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. You will work closely with developers, Business Analysts, Requirement Engineers and architects to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final step.


**Educational Qualification:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design, develop and maintain **automated tests** using **Python and/or Java** and appropriate test automation frameworks.
* Apply **AI-assisted and agentic testing** approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis and maintenance.
* Test **data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality** and data transformations across GCP.
* Validate **rule-based detection engines** and complex business logic used in Financial Crime Prevention.
* Test **APIs, integrations and real-time data flows** across distributed systems.
* Define and continuously improve **test strategy**, regression coverage, integration testing and end-to-end testing.
* Integrate automated testing into **CI/CD pipelines** and development workflows.

* Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them.

**Technical Skills & Expertise:**


* **8–10+ years** of experience in Test automation, technical testing, quality engineering or testing of complex software systems.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing **test automation solutions and frameworks**.
* Strong programming skills in **Python and/or Java**, together with good **SQL** knowledge.
* Practical experience with **AI-assisted or agentic testing** within the software testing lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with **Google Cloud Platform**, preferably **BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Composer**.
* Strong experience in **data, ETL and data quality testing**.
* Experience testing **rule-based systems, decision engines** or complex business logic.
* Good understanding of **APIs, system integrations, CI/CD** and end-to-end testing.
* **B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D.** or equivalent relevant education and professional experience.
* Experience within **banking, Financial Crime Prevention, transaction monitoring, compliance** or another regulated environment.
* Experience applying **AI-enabled development or testing tools** in professional software engineering.
* **ISTQB** or similar testing certification.
* **Google Cloud certification**.
* Requirements Engineering certification, such as **REQB** or equivalent.

**Soft Skills:**


* Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills; understands the relationships between data, technology, business requirements and controls.
* Proactive, delivery-focused mindset with ownership and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional agile team.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
* Collaborative; sees quality as a shared responsibility throughout the development lifecycle.

title: Key Account Manager – Professional Services
description:
Frends is a Nordic iPaaS platform used by more than 6,000 customers across 16 countries. We connect systems, automate workflows and manage APIs, and our Professional Services team turns the platform into real business outcomes for our customers.


Recognized for the fourth consecutive year in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, with G2 awards and a 4.7/5 rating on Gartner Peer Insights.


Professional Services is a growing part of our business, and we’re strengthening our team. We’re looking for a **Key Account Manager for Professional Services** to grow our services business in Sweden.


### **What you’ll do**


**In this role you focus on Frends Professional Services (PS):** the integration projects that turn our platform into real business outcomes, and the ongoing partnership, service commitments and SLAs that follow.


**This is not a prospecting role.** Our Account Executives (AEs) bring the opportunities. You step in where a PS or integration project is the right next step, and you own the scoping, pricing and closing of that project together with the team. Alongside this, you carry your own portfolio of customers across the private and public sectors. You’ll work closely with our AEs, CSMs, Solution Engineers and Professional Services organisation.


* **Build project proposals** – Translate a customer problem into a scoped, priced delivery plan with internal stakeholders, and sell the value of the delivered project.
* **Build the relationships** – Beyond the project: the ongoing partnership, service commitments and SLAs that keep customers with Frends. This includes CIOs, IT leaders and the technical stakeholders who decide how integration gets done.
* **Manage a defined portfolio** – Maintain relationships and find new PS opportunities within existing accounts.
* **Lead project steering** – Take part in customer steering meetings and support delivery leadership together with our Professional Services organisation.
* **Team-sell** – Work with the PS delivery teams so what we promise is what we deliver.
* **Own the numbers** – Take responsibility for customer revenue and profitability within your accounts.

**This could be you** if you work today as an affärschef, key account manager or account manager at an IT consultancy, system integrator or ERP partner. Maybe much of your sales so far has been resources or framework agreements. If you’ve also sold projects or service deals and want to do more of that, we’d like to hear from you.


### **You won't do this alone**


You'll lead the commercial conversation, but you'll scope and price every engagement together with our Professional Services delivery organisation and internal stakeholders. This role is about owning the customer relationship and the commercial outcome — not about being the only person in the room who can build the numbers.


### **What you bring**


* **A track record in selling complex technical services** – integration, data, ERP, cloud or similar. You’ve owned the commercial side of project or service deals and worked with delivery colleagues to scope and price them.
* **Project proposal skills** – you understand how to size and price a delivery project together with the team and present a compelling business case.
* **Strong communication & stakeholder skills** – You can engage technical and business stakeholders (CIOs, IT managers, project sponsors) and collaborate effectively across internal teams.

**Logistics:** The role requires fluency in written and spoken Swedish and English, as well as living in Sweden with a valid work permit. We support a hybrid work model, but we also prefer you to visit our Stockholm office when needed to ensure smooth collaboration and team spirit.


**Travelling** is required to meet the team, internal stakeholders, customers, and to attend key industry events. Our Professional Services team is based in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Finland, and our sales kick-offs are held in Finland twice a year. This means you will also have opportunities to visit Finland and our Frends headquarters.


### **Why Frends**


* **Work Flexibly** – A hybrid work model that adapts to your life.
* **Visible Impact** – Your work directly shapes how Swedish organisations integrate and automate.
* **"Get Things Done" Mentality:** We value outcomes over corporate politics or endless approval chains — and we have a real mandate to make good deals happen.
* **Join an Established Team, not starting from zero:** You'll work alongside KAMs, CSMs, AEs, Solution Engineers and the professional services organisation.
* **Team Selling, not lone selling** – You'll have technical experts and delivery colleagues beside you.
* **Nordic Leader, Global Challenger** – Join one of the leading Nordic integration technology organisations and help us win as the leading European alternative.
* **Competitive Compensation** – A fixed salary commensurate with your experience, plus performance-based, uncapped commission and benefits (e.g. pension, health, phone).

Read on our blog why people choose Frends and why Frendszies stay with us.


### **Interested?**


We're looking for the right person, not the fastest hire. If this sounds like you, even if you don't tick every box, we'd like to hear from you. Get in touch and let's connect!


**Additional Information**


* **Start:** Ideally at the beginning of 2027.
* **Contract:** Permanent.
* **Reporting line:** Direct report to the Service Sales Lead, Frends.
* **Process:** Meet at least our People team, the Service Sales Lead, a team member and the leadership team. The process includes a case assignment and reference checks.
* **Please note:** we do not accept applications submitted by email.

Need more information? Please contact Elina Salo, People Integrator, elina.salo@frends.com.

We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.  

  

Join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS. At AWS Enterprise Support we're looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless, GenAI, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

  

As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB and RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Bedrock, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents trade-offs and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical direction to help plan and build solutions using standard methodologies and enthusiastically keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will empower you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.  

  

We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in IT operations and related areas such as Linux/Windows systems administration, DevOps, Data Analytics, and more. The TAM is our centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers so if you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* You'll build solutions provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy while reducing cost and complexity
* Develop trusting relationships with customers understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Using your technical acumen and customer obsession you'll drive technical discussions regarding incidents trade-offs and risk management
* Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C-suite executives
* Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects Business Developers Professional Services Consultants and Sales Account Managers
* With a bias for action you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS

title: Partner Development Manager - Swedish Market
description:

Leads the creation of a strategic vision rooted to the partners impact and potential across segments. Sells account vision to decision makers and complex partners by aligning overall Microsoft value proposition and value propositions of products, channels, or solutions to the partner's business goals. Identifies market opportunities based on industry gaps and emerging trends in solution/product areas. Engages partners and develops a trusted-advisor relationship with partners to establish strategic alignment and drive growth. Leads business-design briefings advising partner leadership on building a high-impact Microsoft Services practice. Possesses a challenger sales mindset and begins to apply this in interactions with partners. Helps lead campaigns with various functional areas and the partners marketing teams. Leads and implements assessments of the partners' journey of building world-class teams and helps to oversee the sharing of assessment results with other Partner Development Managers and the partners. Leverages internal resources to develop Go-to-Market (GTM) and co-selling strategies that define activities and expectations to meet Microsoft and partner sales goals. Supports partner readiness by assisting partners in the development and execution of marketing plans with guidance to generate customer sales. Ensures results on partner's behalf through resolution of complex and urgent escalations.

 **Responsibilities**  

**Microsoft Business Leader**
Evaluates managed partner portfolio to identify patterns, opportunities, and gaps in partner accounts. Proposes existing products and solutions or recommends new solutions in which partners can jointly invest to fill gaps. Aligns partner needs and interests with market opportunities. Applies working knowledge to build and maintain Quarterly Execution Plans focused on Core & New to build a healthy portfolio of solutions offerings, ensuring security and privacy requirements are met.
Uses Challenger mindset to influence and engage partners and develop a trusted-advisor relationship with senior level leaders and partners to establish strategic alignment and drive growth. Understands and aligns partners' priorities, strategies, and goals with Microsoft’s to build mutually beneficial account plans. Builds and maintains trusted advisor relationships with partner through a deep understanding of their local strategy and business imperatives. Identifies and clearly articulates business opportunities for partners and suggests ways to pursue them.
Fosters a broad stakeholder map.
Helps lead the integration of skills, capability, and capacity plans for the partner business. Influences partner to create a learning culture. Applies and offers various sales and tech trainings and bootcamps to increase the partners' capabilities. Helps lead campaigns to drive growth and transformation. Helps lead the creation of local strategies to align capacity and capability of the partner to compete, gain, and win share for Microsoft solutions to expand platform and sockets for services while prioritizing secure design and operations. Helps lead efforts to build and scale partner digital selling capabilities. Monitors market landscape and partner's impact and uses this knowledge to influence the local strategy in business planning decisions.
Leads the creation of a strategic vision rooted to the Partners impact and potential across segments. Demonstrates an expert understanding of the industry and Partners business and conveys the value of partnering with Microsoft based on the business opportunity and possible competition. Responsible for establishing new market partnerships by working with market makers and making connections. Begins to think longer term regarding the possibility of making larger deals. Establishes long-term strategic vision for the partnership, creating opportunities for deeper commitments. Sells account vision to and shares market opportunities decision makers and complex partners by aligning overall Microsoft value proposition and value propositions of products, channels, or solutions to the partner's business goals. Leads prep sessions and roundtables to influence partners strategy and builds stakeholder maps to expand network and identify market opportunities based on industry gaps and emerging trends in solution/product areas. Develops and maintains in-depth knowledge of products, channels, end customers, and industry and market trends, including security landscape, to share with partner(s).
Upholds Microsoft policies, procedures, and/or legal compliance standards. Delivers and influences mid-term partnership horizons. Drives understanding of the multiple facets of a partnership.
Leads Business Design briefings to architect framework for partnership to optimize mutual success, advising partner leadership on building a high-impact Microsoft partner practice. Develops and executes strategic partner business plans directly aligned with field goals and objectives for all managed partners that grow partner business and promote cloud consumption and digital transformation. Develops plans that fully consider short- and long-term goals and performance expectations that are aligned with partner’s needs and capabilities. Shares expert knowledge with partners, to create strategies with line of business executives that challenge the partners to consider new or different ways to grow businesses. Champions Microsoft as a valued partner by aligning vision for tech and services with future opportunities to transform how we compete. Drives a strategic, effective, and actionable World-class Account Plan to land Global Partner Solutions (GPS) priorities.
Establishes and maintains partner Rhythm of Business (RoB) across all levels and takes share as appropriate. Brings deep subject matter expertise to enrich designs and plans.
**Partner Assessment and Qualification**
Recruits new partners and leverages current partners to grow business. Interacts with partners and key decision makers to identify new opportunities to sell Microsoft products and services.
**Partner Performance and Impact**
Leads and implements assessments of the partners' journey of building world class teams and helps to oversee the sharing of assessment results with other Partner Development Managers and the partners. Helps others lead and implement with Intelligent Edge/Intelligent Cloud to create strategic alignment through strong storytelling with local partner executives to gain commitment to build their selling/technical skill sets and incentivizes for their customers. Influences and plays an active role in Cloud sales transformation (e.g., readiness, compensation, territories)
Ensures results on partner's behalf through resolution of complex and urgent escalations. Leads the orchestration of response to the partner to ensure timely action and resolution from internal teams. Executes a rhythm of business (RoB) for regular partner reviews and quarterly business reviews (e.g., MBRs, QBRs) to track plan execution, identify gaps and agree on any correction of errors in alignment with appropriate stakeholders. Advocates to and guides other groups in prioritizing partners' solutions and issues. Champions internal processes that benefit partners and brings insights into the organization around what the partner experience looks like. Advocates for the development of relationships with Channel Sales counterparts (PDM, PTS, PMA-MW) in support of Microsoft solutions through partner GTM.
Advocates for partner(s) internally at the local level by connecting partner(s) to Microsoft executives to facilitate local reviews for opportunity pipelines and transformational projects.
Actively seeks opportunities to demonstrate the value of the partner to other organizations within Microsoft.
**Partner Sales and Consumption**
Helps lead campaigns with various functional areas and the partners marketing teams. Oversees planning, campaign tactics, offers, and incentives, while incorporating security-first messaging and practices, and maintaining partner confidentiality. Ensures core activities are agreed upon before executing and helps to coordinate resources. Ensures sales targets are clear and that actions and accountabilities are being routinely followed up. Ensures Launch Excellence with sales readiness, and GTM activities. Supports partner readiness by assisting partners in the development and execution of marketing plans with guidance to generate customer sales (e.g., campaigns, incentives, and promotions). Secures marketing resources (e.g., go to market offers) to assist partners with developing marketing plans. Provides support to partners on deals to gain commercial and consumer share. Helps ensure Launch Excellence by supporting Partner sales readiness and go-to-market activities.
Demonstrates a basic understanding of GTM programs and runs generic campaigns. Builds and launches integrated industry specific offerings on Marketplace with partners.
Leverages internal resources to develop go-to-market and co-selling strategies that define activities and expectations to meet Microsoft and partner sales goals. Prioritizes accounts for developing go-to-market strategies. Advises partner on meeting various programs, initiatives, sales, incentive, and tech requirements. Shadows other Partner Development Managers (PDMs) through orchestration and acceleration of removing roadblocks, including internal escalation(s) as needed. Helps partners understand what a consumption-led business is and how it operates, coaches partners around consumption economics (e.g., leverages reports, analyses, etc.). Demonstrates effective pipeline management and limited seller mobilization with leadership sponsorship. Identifies co-selling and customer transactions through Marketplace.
Possesses a challenger sales mindset and begins to apply this in interactions with partners. Orchestrates reviews of Partner’s pipeline, top deals, and consumption targets. Coaches the partner on top deals and ensure close alignment between the partners sales team, channel managers, and other relevant teams. Supports the partners sales leaders on how to overcome obstacles, compete, create deal proposals, etc. Helps lead the development of partnerships with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) to gain support for strategic transformational initiatives to drive incremental cloud growth. Influences the development of partnerships across the Microsoft and partner sales teams to manage pipeline and drive large opportunities/deals. Influences how partners are guided through Digital transformation by building Digital capabilities with a Challenger mindset: sharing ideas, perspectives, and building a trusted advisory relationship.
Drives partner integration of the common sales and delivery methodology for Microsoft for customer opportunities, helps accelerate pipeline by removing blockers, and helps drive key sales motions, programs, and incentives with their partner. Helps identify new opportunities with partner, document in MSX, connect Microsoft and partner sellers, and help move through sales stages.
Demonstrates strong pipeline ownership, translating into advanced deal control and forecasting.  

**Qualifications**  

### **Required/minimum qualifications**


Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Operations, Computer Science or a related field AND relevant experience in partner management, sales, business development, or partner channel development in the technology industry or related experience OR equivalent experience.### **Additional or preferred qualifications**


Master's Degree in Business Administration, Business Science, or an advanced degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) or a related field AND extensive experience in partner management, sales, business development, or partner channel development in the technology industry or related experience OR equivalent experience.  


  

  

Partner Development Management IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across Sweden is kr 651,000.00 - kr 962,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.


Find additional benefits and pay information here:  

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/sweden-corporate-pay.html

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.
